source.text:
מלכותך מלכות כל עלמים וממשלתך בכל דור ודור׃
נאמן אלוהים בדבריו וחסיד בכול מעשיו׃
source.note: Provisional editorial composite, not a transcription of one manuscript or a recovered autograph. The unpointed text retains the declared base except for the recorded changes; interpretive vocalization outside those changes follows the base.

apparatus.note: The mem stanza is followed by samekh with no nun line. Exact pointed baseline is preserved in restoration_draft.baseline.source.

apparatus.reading: נאמן אלוהים בדבריו וחסיד בכול מעשיו
apparatus.note: No supplied or uncertain letters are marked in this published excerpt. God, not YHWH; no all before words. The adjacent recurring blessings are not imported. Published transcription, not new pixel reading.

apparatus.witness: Swete II, Greek Psalm 144, printed p.409 / PDF427, nun couplet printed at 14
apparatus.reading: πιστὸς Κύριος ἐν τοῖς λόγοις αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὅσιος ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ.
apparatus.note: Vaticanus-oriented selected Greek has Lord and no all before words, without 11Q5's recurrent blessings. Its apparatus reports all before words in א c.a, R and T. Edition reports are not fresh manuscript collations or independent Hebrew votes.
